panel.title: Wallpaper Widget

wallpaper_dir.label: Wallpaper Directory
wallpaper_dir.description: Path to your wallpapers folder. Leave empty to use Noctalia's default.

apply_palette.label: Apply Color Palette
apply_palette.description: Automatically apply the collection's assigned color palette to Noctalia when applying a wallpaper.

notify_on_change.label: Notify on Change
notify_on_change.description: Show a desktop notification when the wallpaper or favorite status changes.

close_on_apply.label: Close on Apply
close_on_apply.description: Automatically close the Wallpaper Widget carousel after applying a wallpaper.

add_folder_path.label: + Add Collection: Folder
add_folder_path.description: Select a folder to add to your collections. (To modify or delete collections, edit ~/.config/noctalia/wallpaper-collections.json).

add_palette_type.label: + Add Collection: Palette Type
add_palette_type.description: Choose palette source type (Built-in, Wallpaper dynamic, Community, or Custom).

add_palette_name.label: + Add Collection: Palette Name
add_palette_name.description: Name of the palette (e.g. Nord, Gruvbox, Dim, soft). Leave empty to match folder name.
